title: Is technical difficulty associated with the accuracy of patient-specific implants for maxillary repositioning in minimally invasive orthognathic surgery?
html: The use of patient-specific implants (PSIs) in minimally invasive orthognathic surgery remains limited due to concerns about technical difficulty and restricted intraoperative exposure. Whether increasing maxillary movement technical difficulty compromises the accuracy of PSI-assisted minimally invasive surgery remains unclear. This retrospective cohort study evaluated the accuracy of maxillary repositioning using PSIs in minimally invasive bimaxillary orthognathic surgery and its relationship to technical difficulty.
